title: Methyldecanoate isolated from marine algae Turbinaria ornata enhances immunomodulation in LPS-induced inflammatory reactions in RAW 264.7 macrophages via iNOS/NFkappaB pathway.
authors: Bhardwaj, Meenakshi; Sali, Veeresh Kumar; Malarvizhi, R; Mani, Sugumar; Padmavathy, T K; Vasanthi, Hannah Rachel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海藻提取物在巨噬细胞中的抗炎免疫调节作用，仅涉及NFkappaB蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study identifies the anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory potential of a fatty acid methyl ester segregated from the brown algae Turbinaria ornata and identified by nuclear magnetic resonance and mass spectrometry as methyl 6,12-dimethyltridecanoate (ET). Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects of ET were studied on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced inflammatory reaction in RAW 264.7 macrophages. Moreover, in silico docking studies of isolated ET with inflammatory markers TNFalpha, NFkappaB, and COX-2 showed potent binding scores suggesting anti-inflammatory potential. ET significantly reduced LPO and increased LPS-induced SOD, catalase, and GSH levels. Molecular docking results were further confirmed by checking mRNA levels of selected cytokines (IL6 and IL10), followed by protein expression of iNOS and NFkappaB in LPS-induced macrophages. ET significantly upregulated the expression of IL10 and downregulated the expression of IL6, iNOS, and NFkappaB, confirming the inhibition of LPS-induced inflammation via the iNOS/NFkappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究鉴定了一种从褐藻Turbinaria ornata中分离的脂肪酸甲酯，并通过核磁共振和质谱分析确定其为6,12-二甲基十三烷酸甲酯（ET），并评估了其抗炎、抗氧化和免疫调节潜力。在RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中，研究了ET对脂多糖（LPS）诱导炎症反应的抗氧化和抗炎作用。此外，对分离的ET与炎症标志物TNFalpha、NFkappaB和COX-2进行的计算机模拟对接研究显示，其具有强效结合评分，表明其具有抗炎潜力。ET显著降低了脂质过氧化（LPO）水平，并增加了LPS诱导的SOD、过氧化氢酶和GSH水平。分子对接结果通过检测LPS诱导巨噬细胞中选定细胞因子（IL6和IL10）的mRNA水平，以及随后iNOS和NFkappaB的蛋白表达得到进一步证实。ET显著上调了IL10的表达，并下调了IL6、iNOS和NFkappaB的表达，确认了其通过iNOS/NFkappaB通路抑制LPS诱导的炎症反应。
